notes: New: a sleep timer on the mini player, and a proper YouTube player - playback speed, transport controls, autoplay, a Videos/Music search filter, search autocomplete, tap-to-seek chapters, an uploader card with view and like counts and description, and channel and playlist browsing. Settings gets a default YouTube video quality. Fixed: back from the Media Player and Podcasts tabs closed the app instead of returning to Radio; YouTube search came back empty with no explanation when rate-limited, and now offers a retry; several playback controls were unlabelled for TalkBack. Improved: less battery use while playing, since the audio spectrum capture now idles when nothing is showing it; Settings sections scroll into view when you open them; the Media Player's screen-reader actions call a video a video; and Track details shows the date a file was added.
